task.title: Remove a tree from the list
task.shortdesc: Take a tree off the Workspaces screen without deleting its file.

step.cmd: Choose , then , and find the card of the tree.

stepresult.p: A box named asks you to check. It says the family tree file is not deleted.

step.cmd: Choose in the box, or to stop.

stepresult.p: The card is gone. If you removed the tree that was open and you have another, that one opens.

result.p: The file is still on your . Open it again with at any time. If you remove your last tree, the screen says No workspace open.
